column7: The pump makes roughly 10x the flow the tower wants. Without the bypass it pushes against a closed line and cooks itself

column7: Watertight pass-through where the pipe crosses the tank lid. Otherwise the tank is open around the pipe
column10: Goes through the printed tank lid plate which is flat so no curved surface problem. Price estimate

column2: Gamma2 seal lid. fits 3.5 to 7 gal buckets
column7: Gives the bucket a screw-on lid that the printed tank plate can mount into
column10: Needs a rubber mallet to seat the threaded ring. Measure the centre opening against TANK_PLATE_DIA 235mm on arrival. Price estimate

column2: Water level. Non-contact. Also detects pump failure via level rise
column7: Tank level. Doubles as pump failure detection. An unexplained level rise means the tower drained back
column10: Mounted in the tank lid plate

column2: Water temperature
column7: Water temperature. Warm solution loses dissolved oxygen and bare roots rot fast
column10: 1-Wire

column2: Air temperature and humidity
column7: Air temp and humidity. Tells me whether the grow space is drying the leaves out or too humid
column10: I2C

column2: Full spectrum grow strip 5m 5050. Red/blue 4:1
column7: Indoor tower with no sun on it. Without light nothing grows at all
column10: 5m reel is the standard unit. Buying 4 separate 1m lengths costs more per metre and needs connectors. Cut into 4 x 800mm and wire in parallel. Price estimate

column2: LEDdrop aluminium channel with diffuser and end caps. 5 x 1m segments
column7: Heatsinks the strip. Bare led tape on plastic cooks itself and dims within months
column10: 5 per pack is the smallest sold. Next size up is a 10 pack. I need 3.2m so one pack with a spare metre. Price estimate

column2: GALYGG 12V 8.5A 100W switching supply. metal case
column7: Only power supply in the build. Runs the lights and the dosers off one rail
column10: Built in fuse plus short circuit and overload protection. Worth it for a permanent install near water. Price estimate

column2: External cable rail wiring
column7: Wet environment. Lets me unplug a sensor instead of cutting it out of the loom
column10: No link yet. Pin counts depend on the final loom so i will pick the kit once the hat is laid out and i know the channel count. Price estimate

column2: Garden Hour 16in plant saucer. 2.25in deep
column7: Passive leak containment under the whole assembly. Works when software sensors and plumbing have all failed
column10: 16in vs the 302mm bucket so it catches drips fine. Holds about 7 L not the whole 18.9 L tank. Could not verify pack count from the listing. Price estimate

column2: Grodan A-OK 1.5in starter plugs. sheet of 98
column7: Seeds need somewhere to germinate before they can go into a net pot
column10: One sheet is 98 plugs and i need 16 at a time. Covers many grows. Price estimate

column1: General Hydroponics Flora Series + pH Control Kit
column2: FloraMicro / FloraGro / FloraBloom plus ph up and ph down
column7: Bare roots in plain water starve. This is the food and the ph chemistry in one box
column10: Replaces 3 lines. For leafy greens i dose micro / gro / ph down which is exactly my 3 pumps. Bloom is for flowering so it sits unused. Kit also includes a manual ph indicator. Price estimate

column2: DFRobot Gravity analog ph sensor/meter kit V2. BNC electrode plus board
column7: Nutrients only dissolve in a narrow ph band. Outside it plants starve while sitting in full solution
column10: Two point calibration. Probe is a wear item. Price estimate

column2: DFRobot Gravity analog conductivity meter V2. K=1 probe
column7: Nutrient strength so I know when to top up. Also confirms a dose actually landed in the tank
column10: 0-20 ms/cm covers nutrient solution. Ac excitation cuts polarisation. Probe life rated >0.5 year. Price estimate

column1: pH and EC calibration solution set
column2: ph 4.00 and 7.00 buffers. 2x 1413 uS/cm ec standard. plus kcl probe storage solution
column7: An uncalibrated probe reads confident nonsense. Also my check that the probe is still honest
column10: Storage solution matters. A ph probe left dry is a dead ph probe. Price estimate

column2: Clean analog reads for the pH and EC boards
column7: The pi has no analog input at all. Without this ph and ec simply cannot be read
column10: Mandatory. The pi has no analog input at all

column2: ALAMSCN 12V peristaltic pump 100mL/min. 2 per pack with L bracket
column7: Doses nutrient a nutrient b and ph down without me standing there with a measuring cup
column10: 2 packs gives 4 pumps. 3 used plus 1 spare. Each pack ships 16ft of 3mm ID tubing so 32ft total and no separate spare tubing line needed. Price estimate

column2: 4 channel mosfet pwm driver. optocoupler isolated. 10A per channel
column7: Drives all four loads: the led strip and the three dosing pumps. The pi cannot switch 12V itself
column10: One board for everything now that led and dosers share a 12V rail. Optocoupler isolation protects the pi. Price estimate

column2: LUERFLEX 1L narrow mouth hdpe reagent bottles. 4 per pack
column7: Holds each concentrate. The cap carries the pump intake tube and a vent hole
column10: 4 per pack and i need 3 so one spare. Drill each cap for the intake tube and a vent. Price estimate

column2: Yellow Jacket 2762. 120V 15A single outlet gfci with manual reset
column7: A 120 V pump sits in an open tank of water. This is the only thing between that and a shock
column10: Manual reset on purpose. Auto reset would re-energise a pump sitting in water without anyone looking at it. Price estimate

column2: Custom raspberry pi hat. 2 layer
column7: Everything between the pi and the tower lives on this board. The adc and every mosfet are on it
column10: idk yet. fill this in once the board is finished and i have a real quote

column2: 18-8 stainless fully threaded DIN 975. one per corner
column7: Clamps the whole stack in compression. Replaces 16 heat set inserts and 16 bolts
column10: Cut each to about 890mm. Stainless because the tower sits in a humid room. Price estimate

column2: 8 nyloc nuts and 8 washers. 2 per rod
column7: Holds the rods in tension. Nyloc because a tower next to a pump will vibrate plain nuts loose
column10: No link yet. Washers matter here since the clearance hole is deliberately oversized. Price estimate
